visualReview.notes: Connected Neues Museum exterior and shared Kolonnadenhof colonnade: exact parent outline, three stone/brick facade levels, two central pediments/grouped tall window bays, raised gabled hall, two large mapped blue-green glazed court roofs, mapped low corner domes/skylights and small roof lantern proxies. The complete mapped U-shaped outdoor colonnade replaces its solid generic proxy with 124 open supports and a thin roof. Its floor retains original garden ground and paths. Lower central entrance has an actual 1.2m recess, closed soffit and threshold. Ordinary east/west/aerial pictures plus cached standard PMTiles/Mapzen guided one continuous author/inspect/fix pass. Neighboring museum buildings remain separate; reliefs are original schematic blocks, with no copied figures/text, banners, furnished galleries or art collections.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Six material roles share five existing 256px graphs: stone_limestone (wall/trim variants), brick, metal_standing_seam, storefront and metal_painted. Canonical metric UVs, sRGB-to-linear tint and baked graph means for skyline. Six textured draws/one skyline; no embedded image, private atlas or new graph. Separate POSITION/NORMAL streams and equal CPU/GPU geometry accounting. Each used graph reads once and unloading disposes all geometry. Flat portable/shared/synthetic planes intersect native-grade foundations and bury much of the distant colonnade; turntables without a plane and original native terrain show the complete geometry.

mediumFiReview.notes: Four authored LODs 454 / 3902 / 15058 / 25632 triangles; initial skyline+district geometry 437528 bytes, closeup 2336268 bytes. Six GLBs zero Khronos errors/warnings, 1,440 actual mesh/contact probes and 16 PMTiles13/14/15 cases including nine detailed owned records. Inspected 52 current source/shared/medium-fi/native frames. Street uses planar window jambs with projecting sills; closeup carries individual frames and support pads. Four LODs/failure/unload preserve 986 resident/1318 wider independent buildings, original 201x201/6m ground/roads and 134,371.781m² water. Failure keeps all 995 resident originals. Every run restores ground/water with zero live model geometry. Default synthetic street framing covers one wing rather than the entire enlarged ensemble, and arbitrary synthetic neighbors may overlap its wide footprint. Custom views cover the museum; native views establish geography. The west native detail is partly occluded by the retained independent James-Simon-Galerie proxy. Flat review planes hide parts of the terrain-following outdoor colonnade; they do not establish ground fit.

frameReview.method: Actually inspected52 current frames in eleven labeled contact sheets plus full-resolution current-geometry native entrance, east/west facade, roof and complete-site views. Three ordinary exterior pictures plus cached standard PMTiles/Mapzen guided one continuous author/inspect/fix pass. Corrected integral roof-part ownership, replaced the entire shared outdoor colonnade solid proxy with open supports, used mapped roof polygons/dome centers and fixed lower-door depth and collinear roof joints. Flat review planes hide distant grade-specific colonnade sections; unchanged native terrain supplies fit evidence. West native facade is partly hidden by the retained independent modern-gallery proxy. No bespoke terrain/survey research

limitations: Neues Museum connected exterior on its exact PMTiles footprint: warm pale stone and restrained restored brick, three facade levels, central east/west pediments and tall grouped window bays, shared mapped U-shaped outdoor colonnade with open gaps and original terrain under its roof, dark shallow wing roofs, two broad blue-green glazed court roofs, raised central gabled hall and two low corner dome/skylight forms. Covered courts remain covered; no invented open courtyard, copied relief figures/inscriptions, banners, furnished galleries or neighboring James-Simon-Galerie/Alte Nationalgalerie/Pergamon geometry.
